alpha1.name: Sensitive Clone Proliferation Rate
alpha1.conceptual_reference: Gatenby RA, et al. Cancer Res, 2009 (PMID: 19447936) - Adaptive therapy concept, value calibrated for in silico simulations.
alpha1.description: Intrinsic growth rate of drug-sensitive tumor populations under abundant resource levels.

alpha2.name: Resistant Clone Proliferation Rate
alpha2.conceptual_reference: Silk AL, et al. Nat Commun, 2015 (PMID: 26500125) - Evolutionary trade-off dynamics.
alpha2.description: Growth speed of resistant clones incorporating the evolutionary fitness cost penalty (α₂ < α₁).

ES.name: Sensitive Drug Efficacy Coefficient
ES.description: Chemotherapy efficacy constant targeting sensitive cells, derived from cell line screens.

ER.name: Resistant Drug Efficacy Coefficient
ER.conceptual_reference: Engelman JA, et al. Science, 2007 (PMID: 17463250) - MET amplification resistance concept.
ER.description: Efficacy constant for resistant clones under active drug concentration.

K.name: TME Carrying Capacity
K.conceptual_reference: Michor F, et al. Nat Rev Cancer, 2004 (PMID: 15281884) - Mathematical modeling in oncology.
K.description: Maximum tumor volume supported by microenvironmental boundaries and oxygen diffusion capacity.

ke.name: Drug Elimination Rate Constant
ke.description: Nominal plasma clearance rate for in silico models. Note: True clinical osimertinib t_1/2 is ~48 hours (k_e ≈ 0.35 day⁻¹).

beta.name: Toxicity Accumulation Coefficient
beta.description: Toxicity accumulation coefficient relative to active drug concentration.

gamma.name: Toxicity Recovery Rate Constant
gamma.description: Systemic clearance rate of side-effects under cellular repair cycles.
